data.title: Japan Tobacco to Book $8.6 Billion Loss on Russia Business — Update
data.description:
By Kosaku Narioka

Japan Tobacco expects to book an $8.6 billion loss, cut dividends and reduce executive pay after losing control of its Russian business.

The Japanese tobacco maker said Thursday that it can no longer make business decisions concerning its Russian operations as it did previously and would record a special loss of 1.377 trillion yen related to the loss of control.

Earlier this month, Japan Tobacco said all seven of its Russian entities had been placed under temporary administration by a Russian company on the orders of President Vladimir Putin.

The move marked an escalation in Russian measures against Japanese businesses following Tokyo's support for Ukraine and its participation in Western sanctions against Moscow over its 2022 invasion.

Japan Tobacco on Thursday projected a net loss of Y724.00 billion, equivalent to $4.54 billion, for 2026, primarily due to the special loss related to its Russian business.

The company said excluding its Russian entities from consolidated financial reporting doesn't mean it is relinquishing or selling legal ownership of the businesses or withdrawing from Russia.

Japan Tobacco cut its dividend forecast for this year to Y204 a share from Y272 but said it remains confident it can raise dividends in the coming years, supported by profit growth.

The company's Russian operations had about Y1.5 trillion in assets, including goodwill and roughly Y360 billion in cash and deposits, as well as about Y200 billion in liabilities at the end of September.

Japan Tobacco had expected Russia to account for about 10% of its revenue and 25% of adjusted operating profit in 2026.

The company, formerly a state-owned monopoly, was just under 38% owned by the Japanese government at the end of 2025.

Japan Tobacco, whose brands include Winston and Camel, is one of Russia's largest tobacco companies, with a market share of nearly 40%.

The company said it aims to maintain its Russian operations while prioritizing employee safety and will take all available measures to protect its business rights and assets.

Its board also decided to halve the monthly base pay of five directors, including Chairman Shigeaki Okamoto and Chief Executive Takehiko Tsutsui, for two months. Tsutsui and two other representative directors will also forgo their executive bonuses this year.

data.title: UniCredit Strikes Deal With Germany to Clear Path for Commerzbank Takeover
data.description:
By Michael Hennessey

UniCredit reached an agreement with the German government to resolve key issues in the takeover of Commerzbank, clearing the way for the Italian lender to take control of Germany's second-largest listed bank.

To meet Germany's demands, UniCredit agreed to keep Commerzbank's headquarters in Frankfurt, where the bank will remain listed on the stock exchange, according to a letter from UniCredit Chief Executive Officer Andrea Orcel to German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil.

As a concession to UniCredit, Germany will no longer seek to directly nominate members for Commerzbank's supervisory board. In turn, to maintain good relations with Berlin, UniCredit said it has secured government approval for two independent candidates it plans to nominate instead.

Orcel said in a statement that the support from Germany for a "swift handover" will "help provide clarity and momentum for the next phase to the betterment of both Commerzbank's clients and employees."

"We look forward to continuing this constructive engagement with the minister and all remaining stakeholders as we resolve any outstanding questions and, in turn, realize the significant potential of Commerzbank as part of the UniCredit Group," Orcel added.

Commerzbank said in a statement that it welcomed the commitments announced by UniCredit.

"Key decisions will continue to be made in Germany. Employee rights and existing agreements are also explicitly recognized," the German bank said.

Commerzbank said its board would work with UniCredit to build on the strengths of both banks.

UniCredit started building its stake in Commerzbank in September 2024 and has since continued to increase its ownership to just under 50%.

Commerzbank is currently valued at around 41 billion euros ($45 billion), meaning a takeover would rank as Europe's biggest banking deals since the 2008-9 financial crisis.

The European Commission, the executive arm of the European Union, approved the deal earlier this week and said it wouldn't raise competition concerns in the bloc. The European Central Bank approved the deal in October.

UniCredit is now waiting for final regulatory approvals, which it expects to receive by the end of November, to allow it to take control of the bank.

The Italian bank said last week that new governance arrangements and the implementation of its strategy for Commerzbank are expected by the first quarter of 2027.

data.title: Neusoft OneCoreGo® Honored with Red Dot Design Award
data.description:
Neusoft OneCoreGo® Honored with Red Dot Design Award

Neusoft OneCoreGo® Honored with Red Dot Design Award

PR Newswire

SHENYANG, China, Nov. 19, 2026

SHENYANG, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Neusoft OneCoreGo® 7.0 Global In-vehicle Intelligent Mobility Solution has recently been officially honored with the Red Dot Design Award. This achievement comes after it won a German iF Design Award earlier this year, making OneCoreGo® 7.0 a recipient of the world's two renowned top-tier design honors. Centered on the core visual language "One Sight AR Stellar Path", OneCoreGo® 7.0 has earned high recognition from international authoritative judges for both its particle-based, crystal-inspired interactive aesthetic design and the immersive in-vehicle user experience it delivers.

Neusoft's consecutive wins of the iF and Red Dot awards stem from its forward-looking approach: by stepping outside the conventional design mindset of simply "building a visually appealing UI", it has achieved a balanced integration across four critical dimensions: aesthetic experience, perceptual safety, engineering feasibility, and commercial mass production. These are fundamentally underpinned by the full in-vehicle software system capabilities of OneCoreGo® 7.0, which is built on AI empowerment and global adaptation.

OneCoreGo® 7.0, powered by the cross-agent collaboration capability of the One Mate AI mobility companion, and supported by a sub-product matrix including One Map, One Sight, One Cloud, One Pay, One Store, One Link, and One Guard, delivers full-chain global mobility services spanning navigation, in-cabin AR, payment, app ecosystem services, connectivity and security.

‌At its core, OneCoreGo® 7.0 features the One Mate AI mobility companion, which redefines in-vehicle AI capabilities by shifting from passive command execution to scenario-aware proactive intelligence. It connects the full chain of perception, decision-making, interaction, and execution by integrating advanced complex semantic understanding, scenario-level task execution and multimodal interaction, while leveraging the reasoning and comprehension capabilities of multiple large models. AI on this platform is not treated as an add-on voice entry point, but operates as a shared capability layer built on core competencies.

On its global front, OneCoreGo® 7.0 addresses diverse market demands through one unified software core, delivering full global market coverage across more than 130 countries & regions and supporting dozens of languages. It integrates map services, payment solutions, compliance management, and operational capabilities into a unified platform through coordinated operation of One Map, One Pay, One Store and One Guard, which helps automakers significantly reduce redundant development work and cut down their global R&D, verification and operational costs.

Built on the global full-stack capability foundation of OneCoreGo® 7.0, this award-winning solution has moved far beyond the conceptual phase, and is already deployed in mass-produced vehicles from multiple Chinese and international automotive brands, delivering a full commercial closed loop that translates its award-winning design into tangible user experiences.

For more information about Neusoft, please visit www.neusoft.com.

data.title: NetEase Profit, Revenue Fall Amid Lackluster Gaming Performance
data.description:
By Sherry Qin

NetEase's earnings disappointed following lackluster performance of its self-developed games in the third quarter and the absence of a major blockbuster release.

China's second-largest game company said Thursday that quarterly revenue fell 1.8% from a year earlier to 27.85 billion yuan, equivalent to $4.18 billion. That missed the 30.44 billion yuan expected of analysts polled by Visible Alpha.

Net profit declined 2.6% to 8.40 billion yuan, also lower than market expectations of 9.45 billion yuan.

Adjusted net profit, a closely watched metric that excludes share-based compensation expenses, fell 3.2% to 9.50 billion yuan.

NetEase said revenue from games and related value-added services fell 1.7% due to lower revenue from some self-developed games. That compared with 9.7% growth in the previous quarter.

The underwhelming performance comes as growth in China's game market moderates in the second half after a strong start to the year, partly because of a high base for PC games. There was also a lack of blockbuster titles during the critical summer holiday season.

For NetEase, its top line was dragged by the robust performance of evergreen game "Fantasy Westward Journey" last year and the subdued performance of recently launched "Sea of Remnants," Nomura analysts said ahead of the results.

The next highly anticipated title, "Ananta," an open-world role-playing game, is slated to be released in January.

Together with NetEase's evergreen titles, this game could help accelerate gaming revenue growth to 10% from single digits this year, HSBC analysts said in a recent note.

data.title: Here's the precise moment when cyberattacks started increasing exponentially
data.description:
By Steve Goldstein

Bridgewater identifies the release of the high-powered GLM 5.3 model as the point at which cyber attacks started jumping.

It's been a week of hacks and outages that have rattled Americans - and sent cybersecurity stocks flying higher.

One of the world's top hedge funds has identified the exact moment of time when cyber incidents have started to surge.

For all the attention paid to Anthropic (ANT) and OpenAI large language models, it was the release of the high-powered GLM 5.3 by China's Z.ai (HK:2513) that coincided with the current surge, according to an analysis from Bridgewater Associates.

The Westport, Conn. hedge fund, which had $102.4 billion in assets under management at the end of last year, has developed its own time series of cyber incidents, a taxonomy for linking incidents to root causes and a real-time tracking pipeline.

"We are in the middle of an arms race where malicious actors are using agents to find exploitable bugs and defenders are using agents to preemptively find and patch vulnerabilities. While models have significantly accelerated work on both sides of the ledger, the defenders have the much heavier burden of patching all bugs before they can be exploited," said an analysis written by Bridgewater's Hudson Attar and Arhab Habib.

The Bridgewater analysis didn't focus on why GLM is preferred, but the cost difference is obvious. According to OpenRouter, the GLM cost per million tokens of $1.40 compares to as much as $10 on top OpenAI and Anthropic models.

GLM is one of the so-called open-sourced large language models whose underlying architecture is publicly accessible. American hyperscalers including Amazon, Google and Microsoft host GLM models.

Of course, GLM can be used for good as well as bad. Huggingface, the host of AI models that's agreed to be acquired by Nvidia (NVDA), said it turned to GLM 5.2 to defend against an OpenAI rogue agent breach.

The Amplify Cybersecurity ETF HACK jumped 6.1% on Wednesday, and the cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks (PANW) late Wednesday lifted its annual outlook.

-Steve Goldstein

data.title: Deutsche Telekom's Tech Fund Invests $110 Million in Mistral AI
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Deutsche Telekom's technology investment fund has invested around $110 million in Mistral AI as part of the French artificial-intelligence startup's Series D funding round.

The AI company completed its latest financing in September, raising a total of 3 billion euros ($3.29 billion) and lifting its valuation above 21 billion euros with backing from existing investors like Samsung Electronics and ASML Holding as well as new investors such as Advent, funds and accounts managed by BlackRock and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

The round was co-led by Samsung, EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and existing investor PSG Equity.

Deutsche Telekom said Thursday that its T.Capital Tech Fund invested 100 million euros in the round, paving the way for a strategic partnership to bring European artificial intelligence to German enterprises and public institutions.

"The investment marks a first step towards combining Deutsche Telekom's sovereign infrastructure, customer relationships and integration expertise with Mistral's frontier models, enterprise software and deployment capabilities as part of a future strategic partnership," the German company said in a statement.

The companies plan to support German businesses and public institutions to adopt AI, particularly in industrial and regulated sectors, it added.

Mistral AI in September opened a research and operational hub in Munich to advance Industrial AI for European manufacturing and heavy industry.

"We built Mistral so that European enterprises can deploy frontier AI they fully control, on their own data, in their own infrastructure," said Mistral AI Chief Financial Officer Johan Bergqvist. "T.Capital's investment is a strong signal: together, DT and Mistral can bring sovereign, trustworthy AI to German industry and public institutions at scale."

data.title: CORSIA EEU Volume on Xpansiv CBL and IATA ACE Surpasses 1.5 Million Tonnes
data.description:
CORSIA EEU Volume on Xpansiv CBL and IATA ACE Surpasses 1.5 Million Tonnes

Xpansiv, the leading infrastructure provider for the global energy transition markets, today announced that total trading volume in Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) Compliance Phase 1 Eligible Emissions Units (EEUs) has surpassed 1.5 million tonnes as airlines and other market participants step up purchases of the compliance units on the Xpansiv CBL spot exchange and the integrated IATA Aviation Carbon Exchange (ACE).

The milestone reflects growing activity in the CORSIA market as airlines prepare to meet obligations under the scheme’s first compliance phase, which covers 2024 through 2026. More than 50% of the Eligible Emissions Units (EEUs) purchased across IATA ACE and CBL were from aviation companies, more than 40 of which are registered to participate in IATA ACE Compliance Phase 1 (CP1) procurement events.

CORSIA requires airlines to offset covered international aviation emissions above the scheme’s baseline, using EEUs that meet stringent criteria established by the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Of the total volume, more than 1 million tonnes were traded through the CBL GEO CORSIA CP1 contract, which provides a standardized instrument for transacting CORSIA EEUs across a centralized order book. By bringing eligible supply into a standardized contract, CBL GEO CORSIA CP1 supports transparent price discovery and liquidity formation while simplifying access for airlines, trading firms, intermediaries, and other market participants.

Beyond the standardized instrument, project-specific EEUs are actively traded on CBL and IATA ACE. Volume in these units has exceeded 500,000 tonnes.

“The CORSIA market is starting to gain traction, but this is only the beginning. CORSIA is the only global market-based measure for international aviation, and demand for EEUs will grow significantly as it moves into its mandatory phase from 2027, when major aviation markets including China, India, and Brazil will join the scheme, bringing the coverage of international aviation emissions to around 86%. More EEUs will need to come to market to meet that demand. Stability and clarity around carbon markets is essential, giving projects and investors the confidence to bring forward the supply airlines will need. The CBL GEO CORSIA CP1 contract provides airlines with a standardized, transparent instrument to access these units, understand market pricing, and plan purchases,” said Marie Owens Thomsen, IATA’s Senior Vice President, Sustainability and Chief Economist.

In 2020, Xpansiv and IATA launched the IATA Aviation Carbon Exchange to provide airlines and other aviation stakeholders with a secure, transparent, centralized marketplace for carbon credits. The partners have since expanded the infrastructure available to CORSIA participants through project-specific EEU trading, the CBL GEO CORSIA CP1 standardized contract, procurement events, flexible settlement options, and portfolio management support.

“We are seeing broader and more active participation from the aviation sector,” said John Melby, CEO, Xpansiv. “Xpansiv and IATA have worked together for years to deliver practical tools and infrastructure for CORSIA market participants. This volume milestone demonstrates the value of our collaboration and of market-based mechanisms to streamline access for the airline community, provide price transparency, and support robust execution and automated settlement to all market participants.”

The GEO CP1 contract trades on the Xpansiv CBL spot exchange and is available through IATA ACE. CBL and IATA ACE also support trading in project-specific EEUs, giving participants a choice between a standardized contract and individual eligible projects. Integrated settlement and portfolio management capabilities enable airline participants to transact and manage eligible units across multiple registries without maintaining primary accounts at each registry.

CORSIA’s first compliance phase ends in 2026, with airlines required to reconcile and cancel EEUs for their covered obligations. As the compliance cycle progresses, Xpansiv and IATA will continue working with airlines, suppliers, intermediaries, and other stakeholders to improve market access and support the development of a transparent and efficient EEU market.

To learn more about Xpansiv, visit xpansiv.com.

data.title: Follow-up Drill Program to NB26-003 is Underway at VR’s New Boston Copper-Moly-Tungsten-Silver Porphyry Project in Nevada
data.description:
VANCOUVER, British-Columbia, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- VR Resources Limited (“VR” or the “Company”, TSX.V: VRR, FSE: 5VR; OTCQB: VRRCF) is pleased to announce that the follow-up drill program planned for its New Boston copper-moly-tungsten-silver porphyry-skarn project in Nevada is now underway. 


Photo 1. Earth work on site at New Boston last week, in preparation for the drilling that is now underway, in follow-up to the 2,892 ft intersection of polyphase stockwork veining in NB26-003 completed in June and located some 450 metres to the right of this photo. Planned drill holes all benefit from the array of pre-existing roads and trails on the property that are evident in this photo. 

Four to six holes are planned in follow-up to drill hole NB26-003 completed in June which intersected 317 m at 0.77% CuEq*, starting at surface, above 419 m of 0.48% CuEq*, in 2,892 ft (881 m) of continuous polymetallic stockwork veining with moly, copper, tungsten and silver mineralization (NR on Aug. 26, 2026). 

Each planned hole is expected to take 3 – 4 weeks to complete, with results expected through Q1, 2027. 

Each planned hole is collared in mineralized stockwork veins exposed on surface (see Photo 1), similar to NB26-003, which did not hit the bottom of the mineral system through 2,892 ft of drilling.

Overall, the Company has the flexibility to drill on an array of 16 potential sites shown in Figure 1, as identified on its NOI permit with the BLM (Bureau of Land Management). The permitted drill sites span the Jeep Mine area of high DCIP chargeability in the western half of the overall polymetallic porphyry-skarn vein and dyke system exposed on surface over a 3-4 km strike at New Boston.


Figure 1. Blue circles are locations of the 16 drill sites approved in the NOI drill permit for Jeep Mine. Shown is the drill collar and trace for drill hole NB26-003 completed in June. Base map is from the 3D-array DCIP geophysical survey completed at New Boston in 2023, showing IP iso-shells on a conductivity base map, 200m depth slice. Chargeability values at the Jeep Mine range from 15–21 mV/V. Mineralized sheeted veins strike for 2,100 m east-west across Jeep Mine through East Zone.


Figure 2. View east at Jeep Mine from the Blue Ribbon skarns located to the west, at the western end of the 3-4 km skarn and porphyry system at New Boston. Note the array of historic roads and trails available for the follow-up drilling that is now underway. The permitted drill sites shown on the corresponding map in Figure 1 span a strike length of approximately 800 m eastward from NB26-003 at Jeep Mine. Follow-up drilling will test for the eastward continuation of the upper, tungsten bearing mineral interval in NB26-003, in the deep red-brown garnet alteration visible in this photo in front of the drill, and running up the ridgeline and hill to the east. The alteration occurs in host-rock Triassic limestone recrystallized to marble, invaded by multiple phases of porphyry dykes, and crosscut by polyphase stockwork veining.

From Dr. Michael Gunning, Chief Executive Officer of the Company: “We are excited to have a crew and rig back on site at New Boston; the drill is turning! We are executing immediately on the stated use of proceeds from our recent financings in pursuit of near-term value creation potential at the drill bit for our shareholders.

Our goal with this program is to evaluate the lateral extent and volume potential of the mineralization encountered in NB26-003, in all three dimensions. More specifically, the planned follow-up holes are designed to test:

1. the continuation of the tungsten-bearing upper mineral interval in NB26-003 for a strike length of 400 - 500 m to the east (see Figure 2);

2. the depth potential of the mineral system beyond the veining and mineralization extending from surface through the 2,892 ft completed in hole NB26-003, open;

3. the down-dip extent of mineralization in sheeted veins to the north of NB26-003, in relation to the north-dipping host-rock Triassic limestone that is invaded by the Cretaceous-aged polyphase porphyry system.

We are ready. Modeling for this drill program is the result of three years of detailed surface exploration and state-of-the-art airborne and ground geophysical surveys by VR, built upon expert all-be-it sporadic historical work in the 1960’s and 70’s, and culminating in the 2,892 ft intersection in NB26-003 in June.”

Short field videos recorded during the recent CEO site-visit to New Boston are available on the New Boston Project Page on the Company’s website at www.vrr.ca. They further illustrate the key messages for New Boston around vein intensity, road access on the property, the strength of local infrastructure, and the long-standing history and pedigree of the exploration and mining industry in Nevada. Descriptions of the location, geology and history of New Boston can also be found on the Project Page, along with maps, sections, and outcrop, hand sample and drill core photographs.

TECHNICAL INFORMATION

Technical information disclosed by the Company has been prepared in accordance with the Canadian regulatory requirements set out in National Instrument 43-101. Technical information contained in this document, and on the Company’s website, has been reviewed and approved on behalf of the Company by the President & CEO, Dr. Michael Gunning, PhD, P.Geo., a non-independent Qualified Person. 

* The reader is referred to the previous news release dated August 26, 2026, for a fulsome description of the use of the terms mineral interval and CuEq, and an overview of QAQC protocols for geochemical sampling of drill core for the New Boston project.

ABOUT VR RESOURCES LTD.

VR is an established junior exploration company based in Vancouver. VR evaluates, explores and advances opportunities in copper, gold and critical metals in Nevada, USA, and Ontario, Canada. VR applies modern exploration technologies, in-house experience and expertise in greenfields exploration to large-footprint mineral systems in underexplored areas/districts. The foundation of VR is the proven track record of its Board in early-stage exploration, discovery and M&A. VR owns its projects outright and evaluates new opportunities on an ongoing basis, whether by staking or acquisition.

The reader is referred to the Company’s website at www.vrr.ca for current corporate information and up-to-date summaries of exploration projects illustrated with maps, figures, photos and on-site field videos.

data.title: Emaar Celebrates Dubai's Unstoppable Spirit with Spectacular NYE 2027 and Special Performance by Cirque du Soleil

Emaar Celebrates Dubai's Unstoppable Spirit with Spectacular NYE 2027 and Special Performance by Cirque du Soleil

Emaar Celebrates Dubai's Unstoppable Spirit with Spectacular NYE 2027 and Special Performance by Cirque du Soleil

PR Newswire

DUBAI, UAE, Nov. 19, 2026

Burj Park returns with its premium ticketed experience, with demand set to soar

Enhanced fireworks technology elevates the countdown the world tunes in to every year

DUBAI, UAE, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Emaar today announced a landmark collaboration with Cirque du Soleil for Emaar NYE 2027, bringing one of the most recognised names in live entertainment to Downtown Dubai for an extraordinary New Year's Eve celebration.

For over a decade, hundreds of millions have watched Downtown Dubai welcome the new year. On 31 December 2026, that tradition will reach new heights as Cirque du Soleil artists join the countdown, performing as part of a spectacular live production set against Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain and the city's iconic skyline.

The collaboration marks a new chapter for Emaar NYE, with Cirque du Soleil's world-renowned artistry integrated into a larger production designed to deliver an unforgettable experience for audiences in Dubai and around the world.

This year's fireworks display will also feature enhanced technology and design, building on the signature spectacle that has established Downtown Dubai as one of the world's most celebrated New Year's Eve destinations.

Burj Park will once again offer a premium ticketed experience, providing guests with a dedicated setting, exclusive entertainment and exceptional views of the celebrations. With demand growing every year and Cirque du Soleil joining the programme for the first time, tickets are expected to be highly sought after.

Ticket release dates, categories and booking details will be announced soon through Emaar's official channels.

Mohamed Alabbar, Founder of Emaar, said: "Dubai's ambition has always been to move forward and create experiences that capture the world's imagination. Emaar NYE 2027 carries that spirit, bringing together the scale of Downtown Dubai, enhanced fireworks and the extraordinary artistry of Cirque du Soleil. We want everyone celebrating with us to feel the energy, confidence and possibility that define this city as we welcome a new year."

The collaboration promises to make Emaar NYE 2027 one of Downtown Dubai's most ambitious celebrations yet, combining its globally recognised countdown with a new dimension of live entertainment.

Further details on Emaar NYE 2027, including ticket releases and the wider event experience, will be announced soon through the official NYE website, mydubainewyear.emaar.com, and Emaar's official channels. Stay close. This is one to be there for, not to hear about afterwards.

Ant International's Alipay+ to Connect over 50 Global E-Wallets with Pix of Brazil

  • Expanding Alipay+'s national QR scheme connections to 16, spanning Asia, the Middle East and Latin America
  • Enabling international travellers to pay with home wallets at Pix merchants across Brazil, supporting local businesses and inbound tourism

 

Ant International today announced that Alipay+, its global wallet gateway that links over 50 global digital wallets and banking apps, is connected to Pix, Brazil's national instant payment system, expanding cross-border digital payment access for international travellers.

Ant International's global wallet gateway Alipay+ is connecting over 50 e-wallets and banking apps to Pix

Powered by Ant International’s AI-native payment and risk management capabilities, the service allows international travellers using their familiar payment apps to scan Pix QR codes at shops, restaurants, and attractions nationwide, without downloading a new app.

The launch is part of Alipay+'s broader efforts to advance cross-border digital payment connectivity. Through its payment partners, Alipay+ links 150 million merchants with 2.1 billion user accounts globally. It also partners with 16 national QR payment schemes across Asia, Middle East and Latin America, with Pix as the newest addition.

Pix is Brazil's instant payment system, built on public payment infrastructure developed and operated by the Central Bank of Brazil. It's used by over 22.2 million businesses, according to the central bank's 2025 Integrated Report. Bridging this massive local network with international e-wallets and banking apps unlocks seamless cross-border payments at a pivotal moment for Brazil’s inbound tourism, which hit a record 9.3 million international visitors in 2025, up 37.1% year-on-year (OECD).

"Pix is a remarkable example of how payment innovation can transform everyday commerce at scale," said Weixiao Jiang, General Manager for North Asia and the Americas, Alipay+, Ant International. "As Brazil welcomes more international visitors, convenient access to local payment services is increasingly important. We're excited to help connect more international payment apps with Pix, making it easier for visitors to pay while helping local businesses serve more customers from around the world.”

Expanding Digital Payments Across Latin America

The Pix integration builds on Alipay+'s growing payment connectivity across Latin America:

  • In Argentina, Alipay+ connected global wallets and banking apps to the national interoperable QR payment network, Transferencias 3.0 through its partnership with PVS, a leading fintech company in the region.
  • In Mexico, Ant International supported the development of a local digital wallet app with Clip, Mexico’s premier financial ecosystem, Mastercard and Televisa-Univision to advance the adoption of digital payments.
  • In Chile, it also introduced cross-border mobile payment service for international travellers via PVS.
